_comment: Game pool. cpuLoad/gpuLoad are APPROXIMATE coefficients for the FPS model at 1080p High: cpuFps = cpu.gamingScore * cpuLoad, gpuFps = gpu.rasterScore * gpuLoad. Esports titles have high loads (easy to run); heavy sims/AAA titles have low loads. vramGB = VRAM needed to avoid the penalty. ramRecGB may be anything up to 64 (the largest RAM option); the RAM answer is the smallest option >= ramRecGB. Meant to be tuned. Optional 'alsoOn' lists console generations where this game is also a top-15 title (used by the Endless platform filter).
